title: Solid-phase synthesis of polyunsaturated fatty acids facilitates precise structural investigation on FFAR1/4 agonist activities and the inhibition of neutrophil pseudopod formation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,32263-32270
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04836B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yaohong Shi, Yutaro Saito, Masashi Hotta, Mayuko Akita, Akiharu Uwamizu, Junken Aoki, Jun Kunisawa, Shinsuke Sando
We report the construction of a polyunsaturated fatty acid (PUFA) library by the solid-phase synthesis, the investigation of agonist activities for free fatty acid receptors 1 and 4, and the evaluation of anti-inflammatory effect.
